files.name: RemoteLink-Setup-0.2.1-win-x64.exe
files.how: Installer: choose a folder; adds Start-menu and desktop shortcuts and an uninstaller in Apps & features
files.note: Built on Linux with electron-builder + NSIS. Not yet run on a real Windows PC (Wine could not render Electron). Unsigned, so SmartScreen will warn.

files.name: RemoteLink-0.2.1-win-x64.zip
files.how: Portable: unzip and run RemoteLink.exe. Nothing is installed.
files.note: Same app as the installer. Not yet run on real Windows. Unsigned.

files.name: RemoteLink-0.2.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage
files.note: Tested on Debian 13 (Xvfb/X11) as host through the public Render server: consent prompt, SESSION ACTIVE banner, control and view-only sessions. Wayland untested.

files.name: RemoteLink-0.2.1-linux-amd64.deb
files.note: Installed with apt on Debian 13, launched from /opt/RemoteLink and used as host through the Render server (view-only session); removed cleanly with apt remove.

files.name: RemoteLink-Viewer-0.2.1-android-debug.apk
files.how: Allow "install unknown apps" for your browser, then open the APK
files.note: Debug-signed test build. 0.2.1 is not re-tested: the emulator would not boot on the rebuilt test machine. The same viewer code (0.2.0) was tested on an Android 14 emulator: live screen and tap-to-click. Never tested on a physical phone. It cannot share or control the phone itself.

files.name: RemoteLink-0.2.1-source.tar.gz
files.how: Full source: server, desktop, mobile, tests
files.note: Build macOS/iOS from this on a Mac (see DEPLOY.md).
